news.titleEn: Canada Hits Back at U.S. With Tariffs as Trade War Escalates
news.conclusionEn: Canada will impose dollar-for-dollar retaliatory tariffs on about $20 billion of U.S. goods starting Sept. 8, after Washington's new 50% duties on Canadian products.
news.conclusionZh: 加拿大将于9月8日对等反制美国关税，贸易战升级
news.whyEn: The tit-for-tat escalation between two of the world's most integrated economies threatens supply chains in steel, dairy, autos and electronics, and could push prices higher on both sides of the border.
news.whyZh: 涉及钢铁、乳制品等多行业，或推高两国物价并扰乱供应链
news.detailEn: The U.S. imposed 50% tariffs on roughly $20 billion of Canadian goods after three days of talks in Washington collapsed ahead of a Trump-set deadline. Prime Minister Mark Carney called the breakdown a 'miscalculation' and accused Washington of using economic integration 'as a weapon.' Canada's retaliation, set to take effect September 8, will target U.S. steel, dairy, appliances, farm equipment, pulp and paper, and electronics. The dispute marks one of the sharpest breaks yet between the two historically close trading partners, and economists warn it could raise costs for manufacturers and consumers on both sides of the border.
news.detailZh: 美国在为期三天的华盛顿贸易谈判破裂后，对约200亿美元加拿大商品加征50%关税，谈判截止时间为特朗普设定的期限。加拿大总理卡尼称此次破裂是「误判」，并指责华盛顿把经济一体化「当作武器」。加拿大的反制关税将于9月8日生效，目标涵盖美国钢铁、乳制品、家电、农机、纸浆纸张及电子产品。这是两个历来关系紧密的贸易伙伴之间最严重的裂痕之一，经济学家警告此举可能推高两国制造商和消费者的成本。

news.titleEn: Nvidia's 'Expectations Premium' Dogs the Stock After Earnings
news.conclusionEn: Nvidia reports fiscal Q2 2027 earnings after the close Wednesday, with Wall Street expecting revenue near $92 billion and EPS of about $2.09-2.10, roughly double year-ago levels.
news.conclusionZh: 英伟达周三盘后公布财报，预期营收约920亿美元
news.whyEn: As the dominant AI chipmaker, Nvidia's results and guidance are seen as a bellwether for the entire AI trade; options markets are pricing in a roughly 5% share-price swing either way.
news.whyZh: 作为AI芯片风向标，其业绩将左右整个AI板块走势
news.detailEn: Nvidia is expected to report roughly $92 billion in revenue for its fiscal second quarter, up about 97% year over year, with adjusted EPS near $2.09-2.10. The stock has fallen the day after earnings in each of the last four quarters despite beating estimates, a pattern analysts call the 'expectations premium,' as investors demand ever-larger beats to reward the stock. Analysts are watching sales of the newer Vera Rubin systems alongside current-generation Blackwell chips, with Nvidia targeting $1 trillion in cumulative sales through 2027. The report lands the same day as the Fed's preferred inflation gauge, adding to a high-stakes Wednesday for markets.
news.detailZh: 英伟达预计本财季营收约920亿美元，同比增长约97%，调整后每股收益约2.09至2.10美元。过去四个季度，该股均在财报公布后次日下跌，尽管业绩超出预期——分析师将这种现象称为「预期溢价」，即投资者要求业绩超出幅度越来越大才愿意给予正面回应。市场还将关注新一代Vera Rubin系统与现有Blackwell芯片的销售情况，英伟达设定了到2027年累计销售额达1万亿美元的目标。这份财报与美联储最看重的通胀数据同日公布，使本周三成为市场高度关注的一天。

news.titleEn: Jackson Hole Offers Warsh High-Profile Slot to Rebut His Critics
news.conclusionEn: The Fed's preferred inflation gauge (PCE) lands Wednesday, two days before Chair Kevin Warsh delivers his first Jackson Hole keynote amid a rare 9-3 FOMC split over the rate path.
news.conclusionZh: PCE通胀数据周三公布，为沃什周五演讲定调
news.whyEn: Long-term Treasury yields have climbed to two-decade highs on doubts about Warsh's resolve on inflation, so his speech and today's data are among the biggest catalysts for bond and equity markets this week.
news.whyZh: 长债收益率处二十年高位，本周数据与演讲或引发市场波动
news.detailEn: The Bureau of Economic Analysis releases July's Personal Consumption Expenditures data Wednesday, with consensus expecting headline PCE around 3.6% year-over-year and core PCE near 3.2-3.3%, following a rare negative monthly reading in June. Two days later, Fed Chair Kevin Warsh gives his first Jackson Hole keynote since taking over from Jerome Powell, at a symposium themed 'Financial Innovation: Implications for Payments and Policy.' July's FOMC minutes showed a 9-3 vote split, the widest divide among policymakers in roughly two decades, with some members pushing for a rate hike rather than a cut. Investors are watching for any hint of how Warsh will respond to inflation that has stayed above the Fed's 2% target for more than five years.
news.detailZh: 美国经济分析局将于周三公布7月个人消费支出（PCE）物价指数，市场预期整体PCE同比约3.6%，核心PCE约3.2%至3.3%，此前6月曾出现罕见的月度负增长。两天后，美联储主席沃什将自接替鲍威尔以来首次在杰克逊霍尔发表主题演讲，本届研讨会主题为「金融创新：对支付与政策的影响」。7月FOMC会议纪要显示投票以9比3分裂，是约二十年来政策制定者间分歧最大的一次，部分委员甚至主张加息而非降息。投资者正密切关注沃什将如何回应已连续五年多高于美联储2%目标的通胀水平。

news.titleEn: US Signals Shift From Strikes to Economic Pressure on Iran, Oil Prices Swing
news.conclusionEn: Secretary of State Marco Rubio has told foreign counterparts the U.S. does not currently plan new offensive strikes on Iran, shifting focus to economic sanctions and reopening the Strait of Hormuz.
news.conclusionZh: 鲁比奥暗示美国短期内不会对伊朗发动新打击
news.whyEn: The apparent de-escalation, after months of US-Iran conflict, sent oil prices sharply lower as traders priced out fears of a full Hormuz shutdown, though Rubio did not rule out future strikes.
news.whyZh: 局势缓和令油价大幅下跌，但美方未排除未来军事行动
news.detailEn: Rubio reportedly told foreign ministers in recent days that Washington does not expect to launch new offensive strikes against Iran for the time being, instead prioritizing economic pressure and efforts to normalize shipping through the Strait of Hormuz. The signal follows nearly six months of intermittent US-Iran conflict and comes as the Trump administration weighs additional sanctions on Iranian oil, shipping and financial networks. Oil prices fell sharply on the news, with Brent crude dropping more than 6% and WTI down roughly 5% as traders reduced the geopolitical risk premium built into prices. Analysts caution the truce remains fragile, with Rubio reportedly leaving open the possibility of military action if Iran initiates new hostilities.
news.detailZh: 据报道，鲁比奥近期告知多国外长，美方短期内不打算对伊朗发动新的攻击性打击，转而优先采取经济施压手段，并致力于恢复霍尔木兹海峡航运正常化。这一信号出现在美伊断续冲突持续近六个月之后，特朗普政府目前正考虑对伊朗石油、航运及金融网络追加制裁。消息公布后油价大幅下跌，布伦特原油跌幅超过6%，WTI原油跌约5%，交易员因此下调了此前计入油价的地缘政治风险溢价。分析人士提醒，这一缓和局面仍十分脆弱，据报道鲁比奥并未排除若伊朗挑起新一轮冲突，美方仍可能采取军事行动。

news.titleEn: Goldman Says Chinese Easing Hopes Revive With Economy Growing 4%
news.conclusionEn: China's economic growth has slowed to roughly 4% year-over-year, down from 4.3% the prior quarter and below Beijing's 4.5-5% annual target, reviving hopes for monetary stimulus.
news.conclusionZh: 中国经济增速放缓至约4%，宽松预期升温
news.whyEn: Slower growth in the world's second-largest economy affects global trade, commodity demand and supply chains, and renewed stimulus expectations could move Asian and commodity markets.
news.whyZh: 中国增长放缓影响全球贸易与大宗商品需求，刺激预期升温
news.detailEn: China's GDP growth has cooled to about 4% year-over-year, down from 4.3% in the prior quarter and further below the government's official target range of 4.5% to 5% for the year. Goldman Sachs said the slowdown has revived expectations that Beijing will roll out fresh monetary easing measures, such as rate or reserve-requirement cuts, to support the economy. The deceleration follows months of soft domestic consumption and a property-sector downturn that has weighed on growth despite government stimulus efforts earlier in the year. Investors are watching for signals from Chinese policymakers in the coming weeks on whether additional stimulus will be announced.
news.detailZh: 中国国内生产总值同比增速已放缓至约4%，低于上一季度的4.3%，与政府全年4.5%至5%的官方增长目标差距进一步拉大。高盛表示，经济放缓重新点燃了市场对北京可能推出降息、降准等新一轮货币宽松措施以支撑经济的预期。此次减速是在国内消费疲软及房地产行业持续低迷数月之后出现的，尽管今年早些时候政府已推出刺激措施，但增长仍承压。投资者正密切关注中国决策层未来几周是否会释放追加刺激的信号。

news.titleEn: S&P 500 Rises, Treasury Yields Fall as Traders Await Nvidia, Inflation Data
news.conclusionEn: US stocks closed higher Tuesday — the S&P 500 up 0.3% to 7,677, the Nasdaq up 0.7% to 26,151, and the Dow up 0.3% to 53,577 — as Treasury yields fell ahead of Wednesday's key catalysts.
news.conclusionZh: 美股周二收高，为财报与通胀数据公布前铺垫
news.whyEn: The rally shows investors shrugging off Canada-US trade tension for now, but positioning stays cautious with Nvidia earnings and the Fed's inflation gauge both due the next day.
news.whyZh: 投资者暂时无视贸易紧张，但对次日数据保持谨慎
news.detailEn: The S&P 500 gained 0.32% to close at 7,677.28, the Nasdaq Composite rose 0.66% to 26,151.30, and the Dow Jones Industrial Average added 160.24 points, or 0.3%, to 53,577.40 on Tuesday. The benchmark 10-year Treasury yield fell more than 7 basis points to around 4.625% as investors positioned for a heavy news day Wednesday, with Nvidia's earnings after the close and the Fed's preferred PCE inflation gauge in the morning. Nvidia shares rose about 2% ahead of its report. Traders largely looked past the escalating US-Canada tariff dispute, focusing instead on the AI trade and the path of Fed policy.
news.detailZh: 周二标普500指数上涨0.32%，收于7677.28点；纳斯达克综合指数上涨0.66%，报26151.30点；道琼斯工业平均指数上涨160.24点，涨幅0.3%，收于53577.40点。基准10年期美债收益率下跌逾7个基点，至约4.625%附近，投资者正为周三的密集消息面做准备——英伟达将于当日盘后公布财报，美联储最看重的PCE通胀数据也将于当天上午公布。英伟达股价在财报发布前上涨约2%。交易员大体上无视了持续升级的美加关税纠纷，将注意力集中在AI交易及美联储政策路径上。

news.titleEn: Kurdish-Led SDF Agrees to Integrate With Syrian Government Forces
news.conclusionEn: The Kurdish-led Syrian Democratic Forces announced its dissolution as an independent military force, completing its merger into the Syrian national army under a deal with Damascus.
news.conclusionZh: 库尔德主导的叙利亚民主军解散并入国家军队
news.whyEn: The merger removes one of the last major independent armed factions in Syria, reshaping the country's post-war power balance and the future of Kurdish autonomy in the northeast.
news.whyZh: 消除叙最后一支主要独立武装，重塑战后权力格局
news.detailEn: SDF commander Mazloum Abdi announced Tuesday that the Kurdish-led Syrian Democratic Forces has completed its dissolution and merger with the Syrian army, fulfilling a commitment made in an integration agreement signed with Damascus in January. The SDF had controlled much of northeast Syria but lost significant territory to a government offensive earlier this year before agreeing to the merger. In exchange for giving up independent military control, Syria's government has pledged to let Kurdish communities preserve their language and culture, though it has not agreed to any autonomous Kurdish region. The move is seen as a major step in consolidating central authority under Damascus following the country's civil war.
news.detailZh: 叙利亚民主军指挥官马兹卢姆·阿卜迪周二宣布，这支库尔德人主导的武装力量已完成解散，正式并入叙利亚国家军队，履行了今年1月与大马士革签署的整合协议中的承诺。叙利亚民主军此前控制着叙利亚东北部大部分地区，但今年早些时候在政府军攻势下失去大片领土，随后同意合并。作为放弃独立军事控制权的交换，叙利亚政府承诺允许库尔德社区保留自身语言与文化，但未同意设立任何库尔德自治区域。此举被视为叙利亚内战后大马士革巩固中央权力的重要一步。

businessTips.explanationEn: The sunk cost fallacy is the tendency to keep investing time, money or effort into a decision because of what has already been spent, rather than evaluating whether continuing still makes sense going forward. Sunk costs — money or time already spent — cannot be recovered no matter what happens next, so rational decisions should only weigh future costs and benefits. Falling into this trap causes businesses to keep funding failing projects, hold onto bad hires, or maintain broken strategies simply because 'we've already put so much in.' Recognizing sunk costs helps leaders make cleaner, forward-looking decisions.
businessTips.explanationZh: 沉没成本谬误是指人们因为「已经投入了很多」而倾向于继续投入时间、金钱或精力，而不是基于未来是否值得来做判断。沉没成本——已经花掉的钱或时间——无论后续如何都无法收回，因此理性决策应只权衡未来的成本与收益。陷入这一陷阱会导致企业持续为失败项目输血、留用不合适的员工，或坚持已经行不通的战略，理由仅仅是「都已经投入这么多了」。识别沉没成本有助于管理者做出更清晰、面向未来的决策。
businessTips.exampleEn: A company has spent $2 million building a software product that isn't gaining users. Instead of asking whether the $2 million is worth chasing, sound decision-making asks: given where we are now, is investing another $500,000 the best use of that money — regardless of what's already been spent?
businessTips.exampleZh: 一家公司已投入200万美元开发一款用户增长乏力的软件产品。理性的决策方式不是纠结这200万美元「值不值」，而是问：抛开已经花掉的钱不谈，从现在这个起点出发，再投入50万美元是否是这笔钱的最佳用途？

businessTips.explanationEn: A fake door test lets a founder gauge demand for a product idea before it's actually built, by creating a landing page, ad or button that looks like the real offer and measuring how many people click, sign up or pre-order. If enough people show real interest — like entering an email or clicking 'buy now' — that's a signal the idea is worth building. If almost no one engages, the founder saves months of development time and money on an idea nobody wanted. It's one of the cheapest ways to validate a side hustle or new feature before writing a single line of product code.
businessTips.explanationZh: 「假门测试」（烟雾测试）让创始人在真正开发产品之前，先通过落地页、广告或按钮来模拟真实的产品体验，测算有多少人会点击、注册或预订，从而判断需求是否存在。如果有足够多的人表现出真实兴趣——比如留下邮箱或点击「立即购买」——就说明这个想法值得开发；如果几乎无人理会，创始人就能省下几个月开发时间和资金，避免做出无人需要的产品。这是在写下第一行产品代码之前，验证副业或新功能想法最低成本的方式之一。
businessTips.exampleEn: Before building a subscription meal-planning app, a founder runs Facebook ads linking to a simple landing page describing the service and a 'Start Free Trial' button. Clicking the button just shows a 'coming soon, leave your email' message. If thousands of people sign up, that validates demand cheaply; if barely anyone clicks, the idea gets reworked before any code is written.
businessTips.exampleZh: 在开发一款订阅制膳食规划App之前，创始人先投放Facebook广告，链接到一个介绍服务的简单落地页，并设置「开始免费试用」按钮。点击按钮后只会显示「即将上线，请留下邮箱」的提示。如果有成千上万人注册，就以极低成本验证了市场需求；如果几乎无人点击，创始人便可以在写代码之前重新调整这个想法。

businessTips.explanationEn: A core-satellite strategy splits an investment portfolio into two parts: a large 'core' — typically 70-90% — held in low-cost, broadly diversified index funds for stable, long-term growth, and a smaller 'satellite' portion invested in more targeted or higher-conviction bets, such as individual stocks, sector funds or thematic trends. The core keeps the overall portfolio steady and low-fee, while the satellite gives investors room to pursue higher returns or specific opportunities without risking the entire portfolio. This structure balances discipline with flexibility, letting investors participate in market trends without abandoning a solid long-term foundation.
businessTips.explanationZh: 核心-卫星策略将投资组合分为两部分：占比通常达70%至90%的「核心」部分配置于低成本、广泛分散的指数基金，用以实现稳健的长期增长；较小比例的「卫星」部分则投资于更具针对性或高确信度的机会，例如个股、行业基金或主题趋势投资。核心部分让整体组合保持稳定且费用低廉，卫星部分则让投资者有空间追求更高收益或把握特定机会，而不必拿整个组合去冒险。这种结构在纪律性与灵活性之间取得平衡，使投资者既能参与市场趋势，又不至于放弃稳固的长期基础。
businessTips.exampleEn: An investor puts 80% of their portfolio into a broad global index fund as the stable core, then allocates the remaining 20% across a handful of individual AI and renewable-energy stocks they believe will outperform. If those satellite picks do well, returns get a boost; if they underperform, the core still anchors the portfolio's overall stability.
businessTips.exampleZh: 一位投资者将80%的资金投入一只广泛分散的全球指数基金，作为稳定的核心配置，剩余20%则分散投资于几只他看好的AI和新能源个股作为卫星仓位。如果这些卫星持仓表现出色，整体收益会得到提振；即便表现不佳，核心配置仍能为整个组合的稳定性提供支撑。
